intercom_soft_sq_level_1: Soft SQ level, 1 to 9 as on the phone
intercom_play_radio_s_audio: Play the radio's audio in this browser
channels_tick_several_channels_delete: Tick several channels to delete them, star them or put them in a zone
channels_zone_shown_list_radio: Zone shown in the list (the radio steps and scans in it)
channels_zone_add_selected_channels: Zone to add the selected channels to
channels_take_selected_channels_out: Take the selected channels out of the zone shown
channels_click_channel_s_edit: Click a channel's Edit to change it, or New channel. Clicking a channel's name tunes it.
messages_send_by_aprs_callsign: Send by APRS to a callsign
messages_send_by_dmr_text: Send by DMR text to a contact
common_not_a_number: Not a number: write digits with one point or comma as the decimal sign
messages_new_not_yet_tested: New: not yet tested with the real Winlink system. Please tell us if it works for you: report it on GitHub.
messages_goes_out_at_next: It goes out at the next connection.
messages_tune_gateway_s_channel: Tune the gateway's channel first (an analog channel). A session takes minutes: every transmission starts with a 1.6-second lead-in.
messages_detailed_diagnostic_log_timing: Detailed diagnostic log (timing, raw protocol bytes, every radio frame)
messages_include_messages_data_that: Include the messages' data in that log
messages_your_callsign_comes_from: Your callsign comes from the PKT settings. The password is write-only here: it is kept in SignalDeck's private settings and never shown, logged or backed up. Leave it empty to keep the saved one; "-" clears it.
messages_winlink_lists_its_gateways: Winlink lists its gateways at winlink.org (RMS Channels): choose Packet, download the CSV, then import it here. SignalDeck keeps the 1200-baud packet gateways this radio can tune, nearest first (distance worked out on the phone).
messages_send_us_e_mail: Send it to us (e-mail, or attach it to a GitHub issue), whether it worked or not. The password is never in it.
contacts_home_location_grid_square: Home location (grid square or lat, lon)
sstv_sends_current_analog_channel: Sends on the current analog channel. The long modes run up to the radio's own 120 s time-out; after one of them the phone cools down before the next long picture (a short mode can go meanwhile).
sstv_combine_receptions_same_picture: Combine receptions of the same picture
sstv_pass_recording_satellite_passes: A pass recording (Satellite passes → Record each pass), a REC recording, or one from anywhere (Upload…: WAV, MP3, M4A, OGG, FLAC, up to 200 MB), decoded on the phone in the background, faster than it plays; the radio is not used. SSTV finds every mode from its header (Robot, Martin, Scottie, PD…) and Robot 36 pictures whose header was lost. Pictures join the gallery, packets are listed below.
scope_receive_only_radio_sweeps: Receive only: the radio sweeps the band step by step (about a second a step: its signal reading needs 0.7 s after each retune) and comes back to your channel when it stops. Pick a band or a custom range; click the graph to pick a frequency.
scope_band_scope_signal_strength: Band scope: signal strength across the band and a waterfall of the recent sweeps
sat_tracking_follows_every_pass: Tracking follows every pass: the radio tunes a few minutes before it, corrects the Doppler shift and listens only.
sat_grey_normal_cyan_slightly: Grey normal · cyan slightly enhanced · green super-refraction · amber ducting likely. From the weather forecast's lowest layers (Open-Meteo, position rounded to about 50 km); thin ducts near the ground are underestimated.
trans_search_captions_word_callsign: Search the captions (a word, a callsign, a name)
trans_every_finished_caption_sentence: Every finished caption sentence the phone kept, newest first, with its time, channel and (on DMR) the caller. New ones appear as they are heard. Captions are made on the phone: turn TXT on here or on the phone.
trans_phone_speech_recognised_phone: On the phone: speech is recognised on the phone itself, nothing leaves it. The model is downloaded once (over the phone's connection) and kept; bigger models are more accurate but need more space and memory. Google: your own API key, audio is sent to Google.
map_repeaters_around_middle_map: Repeaters around the middle of the map, wherever you have moved it
map_one_repeater_its_range: One repeater: its range calculated from the terrain, under what was measured
rec_rec_intercom_saves_every: REC on the intercom saves every reception to Download/DMR/Audio on the phone.
pkt_listens_across_packet_frequencies: Listens across the packet frequencies (never transmits) and lists the Winlink gateways, BBSs and nodes it hears. Nodes identify only every 10 to 30 minutes: let it run an hour or two, or schedule it for the night. The radio goes back to its channel afterwards.
pkt_upload_recording_any_audio: Upload a recording (any audio file; it is converted to the radio's 8 kHz and cut at 25 s), play it here, then Send it on the current analog channel. Messages recorded on the phone show up here too.
pkt_m17_digital_voice_phone: M17 digital voice on the phone's current channel or VFO: the caller, who it is for and their message; press Listen on the Intercom page to hear the decoded voice. Receive only (this radio cannot transmit M17).
pkt_click_set_transmit_frequency: Click to set the transmit frequency
pkt_wsjt_x_mode_phone: The WSJT-X mode on the phone's current FM channel. Click a CQ to answer it: the phone runs the exchange and logs the contact. It cannot hear SSB FT8 (144.174 / 432.174), and FM lets one station through per slot. Your callsign shows as (you). Sending needs Allow transmit from the web.
pager_ric_numbers_contact_s: To (RIC numbers, or a contact's name or callsign)
settings_start_something_at_set: Start something at a set time, once or every week; when the time is up the radio goes back to what it was doing. A satellite pass being tracked comes first.
settings_packet_finder_listen_bbss: Packet finder (listen for BBSs, nodes, gateways)
settings_take_over_gives_radio: Take over gives the radio to SignalDeck; Hand back returns it to the stock walkie-talkie app (and this page loses the radio until you take it over again).
settings_restart_installing_update_each: Restart and installing an update each ask you to confirm. The firmware loader, Own the radio at boot and Allow unlisted images stay on the phone.
settings_web_access_pin_allow: Web access, the PIN and “Allow transmit from the web” are changed only on the phone (Device → SignalDeck Web), so a browser can never give itself more rights.
settings_restore_from_files_this: Restore from files on this computer (select Contacts.csv, TG_Lists.csv, Channels.csv, Zones.csv and DTMF.csv of one backup or OpenGD77 CPS export)
settings_restore_replaces_every_channel: A restore replaces every channel, contact and zone with the backup; history, messages and settings are kept.

messages_no_ack: No acknowledgement (the text may still have arrived)
